title: Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions
abstract: arXiv:2609.35316v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with clear evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, this function should include more than only a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for a generative AI, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy only measures system capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. translated_title: 面向AI系统的可靠性工程：挑战、方法与方向
translated_abstract: AI可靠性关注的是AI系统是否能在规定的时期内、在规定的运行条件下，以明确的证据可靠地执行其预期功能。随着这些系统变得更加自主，这一功能应不仅限于产生正确的输出。检索、记忆、工具使用、权限、人类监督以及系统之间的交互必须一致且安全地运行，而对于生成式AI而言，产生输出的推理过程也必须如此。平均基准准确率仅衡量系统能力，并不能量化这一更广泛的可靠性主张。本文将成熟的可靠性工程方法——从失效定义、运行包线，到失效模式与影响分析（FMEA）、加速测试、现场监控和可靠性增长——适配到AI系统中。论文提出了一个四级诊断框架，将失效分类为组件级失效、运行回路级失效、智能体行为级失效，以及网络与治理级失效。测试与评……
tldr: 该论文将传统可靠性工程方法（如失效定义、FMEA、加速测试、现场监控与可靠性增长）适配到AI系统，提出四级失效诊断框架，主张超越平均基准准确率来系统性地保障AI系统整体的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods to AI systems, proposes a four-level failure diagnostic framework, and argues that AI reliability must be assessed beyond average benchmark accuracy.
